title: Reason or Recite: Complementary Specialists with an LLM Judge for Traffic Anomaly Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34993v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Road anomalies such as collisions, violations, and sudden hazards demand more from video understanding than detection: a practical system must verify what happened, describe the scene, and explain the cause. We find these competences pull in opposite directions for vision-language models: closed-form questions reward precise, evidence-grounded reasoning, while open-ended answers are scored by similarity to reference text, where matching the annotation style matters as much as reasoning correctly. We present Reason-or-Recite (RoR), a two-specialist framework for the Traffic Anomaly Reasoning track of the 2026 AI City Challenge. RoR (1) rewrites the official chain-of-thought annotations into a structured, temporally grounded schema and LoRA-tunes a 9B vision-language model on the enhanced traces; (2) fine-tunes a 4-bit-quantized 27B model on answers alone, absorbing the annotation style; and (3) selects between the two candidates per que

translated_title: 推理还是背诵：基于LLM裁判的互补专家模型用于交通异常推理
translated_abstract: 诸如碰撞、违规行为和突发危险等道路异常事件对视频理解的要求远不止于检测：一个实用的系统必须验证发生了什么、描述现场情况并解释其原因。我们发现这些能力对视觉-语言模型而言是相互冲突的：封闭式问题奖励精确的、基于证据的推理，而开放式答案则通过与参考文本的相似度来评分，此时匹配标注风格与正确推理同等重要。我们提出了Reason-or-Recite（RoR），这是一个面向2026年AI City Challenge交通异常推理赛道的双专家框架。RoR（1）将官方的思维链标注重写为结构化的、基于时间轴的模式，并利用增强后的推理轨迹对9B视觉-语言模型进行LoRA微调；（2）仅在答案数据上微调一个4-bit量化的27B模型，使其吸收标注风格；（3）通过LLM裁判针对每个问题在两个候选答案中进行选择……
tldr: 该论文提出RoR双专家框架，用一个9B模型学习基于结构化时间推理的能力、一个27B模型学习标注答案风格，再由LLM裁判在两者间择优，从而在交通异常推理任务中同时兼顾精确的证据推理与开放式回答的评分要求。
en_tdlr: RoR is a two-specialist framework in which a 9B VLM learns temporally grounded structured reasoning while a 4-bit-quantized 27B model absorbs annotation style, with an LLM judge selecting between the two candidates to excel at traffic anomaly reasoning.
